product_summary: ITR India (Mumbai) is the Indian branch of the Italian ITR Group (USCO SpA, Modena) — per the group's own contacts page: 'Asia — ITR INDIA, Mumbai, India, www.itrindia.com' (https://itrworld.com/contacts/). The group's product range (https://itrworld.com): undercarriage components (track chains, rollers, idlers, sprockets, track shoes, pins/bushings/shims), rubber tracks & pads, buckets, ground engaging tools (teeth, adapters, cutting edges), repair parts (hydraulics, engine parts, filters, seals, fasteners), demolition equipment (hammers, shears, grapples), tyres, additional products. The Indian site itrindia.com is operated under the brand 'SHAN PARTS — from the House of Shantilal C. Mehta' (ISO 9001:2015, since 1947) and lists: Undercarriage, Swing Bearings, Rock Breaker Parts, Ground Engaging Tools, Cutting Edges & Blades, Buckets & Rippers, Hydraulics, Engine Parts, Transmission Parts, Oil Coolers & Radiators, Paver Parts, Concrete Pump Parts, Buffer Rubbers & Pads, Centrifugal Pre Cleaners, Electrical Parts, Miscellaneous Parts; 22,000+ line items in stock, 6+ distribution centres, 21+ sourcing countries (https://www.itrindia.com/). No customs line was available to me in this task, so no product line is corroborated by a shipment record — all items are 'заявлено, не подтверждено'.
comment: HS 843149 ('parts of machinery of headings 8426, 8429, 8430 — other') is CORRECT for the core undercarriage / ground-engaging-tool / bucket line and is retained as the primary code — no HS-based rejection (Rule 3). However the declared single code covers only part of the actual catalogue: the site's own product list spans many other chapters — swing bearings (8482), hydraulics/pumps/cylinders (8412, 8413), engine & transmission parts (8409, 8483), oil coolers & radiators (8708.91), filters (8421), electrical parts (8511, 8536, 8544), rubber tracks/pads and buffer rubbers (4011, 4016), fasteners (7318), rock-breaker/demolition tools (8207, 8431.49), paver and concrete-pump parts (8474.90, 8413.xx). So the declaration is partial: the main code is right, but the product mix is broader than one HS-6 line. Industry label 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' (metallurgy & mining) is a MISCLASSIFICATION: the company is not a metallurgical producer or miner — it is an aftermarket spare-parts distributor for mining/earthmoving/construction equipment (mining is only an end-use application). Trader signs are explicit: 'aftermarket Spare Parts', 'Distributing only the finest brands of spares', '21+ sourcing countries', '22,000+ line items in stock', 6 distribution centres and 70,000 sq ft of warehousing — i.e. import/resale, not own manufacture; the group does manufacture through its 16 production centres abroad (Italy, China, Korea etc.), but the Indian entity's own site describes distribution. Product lines missing from the declaration: rubber tracks and tyres (4011), swing bearings (8482), hydraulics and pumps (8412/8413), engine/transmission parts (8409/8483), radiators (8708.91), electricals (8511/8536/8544), filters (8421), concrete-pump and paver parts. Note on identity: itrindia.com is branded 'Shantilal C. Mehta / SHAN PARTS' while the ITR Group lists it as its India branch — the legal name 'ITR India Private Limited' itself could not be independently confirmed from a public page in this session (search backend was unavailable; only Bing generic results, no company page), so the legal-entity link between the site and the claimed name is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. No revenue, export volume, CIN or PAN researched per role scope — null.
